subject: Can't get Regex to work with renderdatatable and shiny_0.11.1

messages.author: 919a40c48da677f7
messages.subject: Can't get Regex to work with renderdatatable and shiny_0.11.1
parts:
Hello,

I am having problems getting regex to work iwth renderdatatable. Everything works fine to display the data tables but when I type ^eye|pain$ (want "eye" or "pain") at the bottom of the table to do a search on a specific column I get zero results. I am using shiny_0.11.1. I thought this option would allow me to do regular expression searches: options = list(search = list(regex = TRUE))

# Shiny Server Code 
server <- shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  output$mytable1 <- renderDataTable(
      ae[, input$show_vars1, drop = FALSE],
      options = list(search = list(regex = TRUE))
  )
  
  output$mytable2 <- renderDataTable(
    cm[, input$show_vars2, drop = FALSE],
    options = list(lengthMenu = c(5, 10, 50), pageLength = 5)
  )
  
  output$mytable3 <- renderDataTable(
    lb[, input$show_vars3, drop = FALSE], 
    options = list(lengthMenu = c(5, 10, 50), pageLength = 5)
  )
})



Regards,
David

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Can't get Regex to work with renderdatatable and shiny_0.11.1
parts:
Unfortunately DataTables does not accept per-column configurations for
detailed search options (you can only turn on/off the `searchable`
option for individual columns:
http://datatables.net/reference/option/columnDefs), and it is not
smart enough to infer from the global option regex = TRUE for
individual columns, either. Therefore it is difficult for us to
support this in shiny. You can only use regular expressions in the
global search box. Sorry.

Regards,
Yihui
